scope: Static inspection of exact pinned upstream defaults and execution paths. No native source, task, selection, timeout or running input changes.

new_test_function_filter.interpretation: A test patch that only edits existing test bodies can fail this default filter despite valid regression coverage. C++/Rust added tests using only those unsupported forms also count as no_new_test_funcs. This is static behavior; per-repository observed rejection counts remain separate.

native_parser_dispatch.interpretation: Unsupported text can produce an empty map/no F2P; bootstrap language support alone does not establish runtime-parser coverage. Do not attribute failures to this gate unless the run reaches it.

native_timeout.actual_application: Each pre-fix and post-fix sandbox.exec receives timeout separately, despite the options comment calling it a per-PR cap. Two stages can therefore consume about 1200 seconds before overhead.

generated_vs_native_test_scope.interpretation: Both paths call targeted_test_cmds_for_pr with normalized upstream bootstrap commands and changed test files. Do not describe exported Scanpy controls as a manually selected subset or necessarily the entire repository test suite.

environment_reuse.behavior: A repository-level bootstrap image is created first. Native validation lazily creates one sandbox and reuses it across candidates; stages reset/clean to historical base commits while preserving dependency directories. The stage script does not reinstall repository dependencies for each base.
environment_reuse.observed_case: Matchms smoke/fresh-image tests passed at its pinned newer revision, while PR966 pre/post both failed to import chemap at its historical base.
environment_reuse.limits: This is a source-path explanation of an observed compatibility failure, not a tested alternative environment strategy. No dependency refresh, per-PR bootstrap or repair applied.

targeting_explicit_path_caveat.behavior: targeted_test_cmds_for_pr preserves an existing positional path argument. An explicitly broad directory such as mne/ therefore prevents changed-test-file narrowing. Native validation and export both use this same helper.
targeting_explicit_path_caveat.limits: Intermediate live validation observation, not a terminal result or a control/grade claim. No command/selection/timeout modification or reconstructed test execution was applied.

pytest_ansi_limitation.observed_case: MNE PR14338 pre/post raw logs contain 4896/2844 ANSI sequences and per-test progress, but both unchanged pytest parsers return empty maps.
pytest_ansi_limitation.scope: Live intermediate log census only; original native failure retained. Neither pytest parser strips ANSI; standalone ANSI stripping elsewhere applies to Jest. No normalization/adapter/regrading applied.
